title: AI server tracker: TSMC, Alchip post big October gains powered by 2nm and ASIC orders
html: Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain generally saw strong growth in October, driven mainly by AI and advanced-process demand. TSMC's revenue for that month rose nearly 60% year-over-year, while chip designers are buoyed by large orders from overseas customers.
